finalText:
Migration finished — all 12 remaining call sites across support, orders, catalog, billing, analytics, and accounts now use `db.execute({ sql, params })`.

The only holdout is `vendor\legacy-orm\adapter.js`, which I left alone deliberately: it's a vendored file that gets wholesale-replaced on every upgrade, and its header explicitly warns local edits are silently lost. `cache.query` in `user.js` is unrelated (a cache client, not `db`), so I didn't touch it.
